messages:
maggie: Quick sync  change window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. We have an API toggle, router header-split, and a runtime kernel bump. Need a concise pin + rollback owner.

deploybot: Change window booked 2026-03-23T23:00Z-01:00Z. Locks requested: api, router, runtime. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/change-window

sam: Runtime team: v3.2.2 includes matrix-kernel fix. Canary plan: 5% for 15m. Abort triggers: p95 +180ms OR error-rate >3% OR token throughput drop >12%. Note: KV prefix cache will be invalidated at shift.

leo: Router: we'll pin router-v2.6.2 at T0. If runtime is not pinned, we will not flip header. Console team requested 10m stable window after canary.

tiffany: API will prepare api-v2.6.1 but will only route when router pinned. Release notes draft: /docs/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md (please append header-split caveat).

maggie: Plan (short):
1) pre-T0: clear short TTLs and prime caches
2) T0: pin router + runtime, start 5% canary for 15m
3) T+15m: @sam evaluates metrics -> go/no-go
4) T+25m: if green and stable for 10m, console flips header UI
5) rollback commands below executed by @sam if criteria met

sam: Commands I'll run on thumbs:
```
# pin artifacts
deployctl pin router=router-v2.6.2 runtime=runtime-v3.2.2
# canary
deployctl canary --service router --pct 5 --duration 15m --notify #incidents
```

ops-bot: Alerting updated: notify = #incidents, #eng-oncall. SLO guards: p95 delta >180ms OR error-rate >3% => page oncall and alert #incidents. Auto-failover target: router-v2.5.9.

leo: I'll only flip headers when I see "console: ready" from the console owner. If rollback occurs, console stays on safe path.

maggie: Decision owner at evaluation = @sam. Sam, if you call abort please run rollback and ping #incidents + @ops.

sam: Ack. Rollback flow:
```
# rollback
deployctl rollback router --to router-v2.5.9
deployctl rollback runtime --to runtime-v3.2.1
# reopen api pins to api-v2.5.x if needed
```

tiffany: I'll update release notes after we confirm final pins.

maggie: React with :thumbsup: when ready. We'll reconvene 10m before the window to confirm.

(End of thread)
